card.name: Linking words before history terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'or', 'family', 'after' and 'had' that come just before a medical history or prior-therapy phrase in contraindication and indication lists.

modes.label: Personal or family history
modes.description: The word 'family' or 'personal' or 'or' in the phrase 'personal or family history of' a disease.
